## Directories

This repository is composed of the following directories:

* [packages/interact](packages/interact): a node interact package that permits to generate a website.
* [sites/interact](sites/interact): a documentation website for and generated by the interact package
* [contrib](contrib) - the location for developers artifacts such as:
  * [scripts](contrib/scripts)
  * [documentation](contrib/docs)
  * [IDE configuration](contrib/idea)
